Handoff is at [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).

**Roll back `dep-4471`.** It set `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true`, so every request opened its own connection and drained the 20-slot pool.

Impact ran `02:14:18Z` to `03:59:27Z` and was still going at log end. 530 `503`s, 530 `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`. Queue depth climbed to `waiting=172` and never drained.

The doc also flags what not to touch. Workers were clean, and their latency creep predates the deploy.
